description:
Experience the powerful 1000W single motor of the T8, delivering a peak power of 1500W and a torque of 70Nm, providing excellent performance on various terrains.

Equipped with a 48V 16Ah lithium-ion battery, the T8 e-bike offers an impressive range of 45 to 60 miles on a single charge, ensuring a reliable and long-lasting ride for your adventures.

Enjoy precise and reliable braking with advanced mechanical disc brakes. Designed for consistent stopping power, they offer excellent control and safety in various conditions, ensuring confidence on every ride.

Tackle any terrain with ease using the 7-speed Shimano gearing for smooth shifts. The vibrant LCD display shows real-time updates on speed, battery, and distance. Plus, the BMX handlebars provide a comfortable, stable grip for better control.

The dual-shoulder suspension fork provides excellent shock absorption and stability, ensuring a smooth, controlled ride on rough terrains and uneven surfaces. It enhances comfort and handling, making it ideal for off-road and challenging rides.

The 20"x4" all-terrain fat tires are designed to provide exceptional grip and stability on a variety of surfaces, from sandy beaches to snowy trails. Their large width and rugged tread pattern ensure a smooth, comfortable ride, even on the toughest terrains.

Ride safely day or night with the T8's integrated lighting system, featuring a powerful front headlight, brake light, and turn signals, ensuring enhanced visibility and control on every ride.

Say goodbye to traditional keys. Just double-click the button on the battery key to easily unlock the bike. Enjoy a smarter and more convenient ride.

Our rear light offers the convenience of left turn, right turn, and hazard (emergency) flash settings, ensuring you're always visible and safe while riding.

The front light provides powerful illumination to light up your path. Next to it, you'll find separate left and right turn signal lights, offering added visibility when turning.

When braking, the rear light automatically illuminates in bright red, alerting others of your intentions and enhancing road safety.

The 48V T8 Core features a top speed ranging from 28 MPH to 31 MPH, powered by a 1000W motor with a peak power of 1500W. It is equipped with a dual-shoulder suspension fork and additional shock absorption underneath the seat for added comfort. Perfect for urban and off-road trails, this bike offers excellent performance on various terrains.
